summary: Iteration 8: tested all 5 fixes plus regression. Backend: new test_iteration8_photofit_meal.py (23 tests) all pass; full suite 137/138, the one failure is a known xdist flake in test_guests_wishes_uploads (passes 12/12 when run alone). Frontend at 360x740, 412x800 and 640x900: wizard steps 1-7 have scrollWidth == viewport width; mobile progress label 'Step N of 7: <name>' + bar + wizard-step-select (jumping forward without data is blocked with a toast); desktop tab row only shows at >=640; colour swatches wrap (no overflow), date/time inputs stay inside the card; header and content edges line up at 16px. Meal: 10 options, Lunch -> 'Lunch to follow', Custom shows the custom input ('Biryani to follow'), None hides it; hi/ur lines are translated; live preview and published guest page show card-event-meal; Google Calendar details, ICS DESCRIPTION and og:description ('<date> at <time> · Lunch · Venue') all include the meal. Photo adjust: the dialog opens after upload for hero/feature/event/wishes; all 6 shape chips and 2 style chips work; defaults are full+blended for hero and framed for others; the zoom slider is hidden for full; dragging changes object-position; the zoom slider applies scale; the Adjust button reopens it; photo_fit persists (hero arch x23 y20 zoom1.5 blended) and the guest card-hero-photo has data-shape=arch and data-style=blended; it is still there after reopening the editor. Guest covers at 360x640 (faraz Urdu, demo, the-sharmas, zara): the header line top is 88-120px, nothing covers it (elementFromPoint = header text), the scroller scrolls (scrollHeight > 640), the chip shows date and time only, with no event name.

minor.issue: meal_name/ics_description are English only (MEAL_LABELS + 'to follow'). On hi/ur cards the guest page and Google Calendar link show the translated line (e.g. 'دوپہر...'/'ظہرانہ کا اہتمام ہوگا') while the ICS and WhatsApp preview say 'Lunch to follow' / '· Lunch ·'. This only happens when meal_line is empty.

design_issues.screen: Guest cover 360x640, royal wedding with a blended hero photo (/i/test-meal-sara/e1)
issues: The 'Swipe →' hint pill (swipe-hint) sits on top of the big names line at the bottom of the first screen until the guest swipes

The header line 'Together with their families' and the eyebrow 'TOGETHER WITH THEIR FAMILIES' both show, so the line repeats (from earlier work, not this change). On the Urdu card /i/faraz the default neutral header is in English.
The host cannot clear the meal line: an empty input falls back to the default text right away. This is by design, but there is no way to hide the line other than choosing None.
Hindi default reads 'दोपहर का भोजन की व्यवस्था रहेगी'; grammatically it should be 'दोपहर के भोजन की व्यवस्था रहेगी'

action_items: Optional: localise meal name/line in the backend ICS + share description for hi/ur cards (or store the resolved line), so they match the guest page
Optional: move or hide the swipe hint so it does not cover the names on the cover at 360x640
Optional: fix the Hindi meal line grammar ('का' -> 'के')
critical_code_review_comments: StepEvents MealField: value={ev.meal_line || line} means the line cannot be set to empty; acceptable, but document it

PhotoAdjust drag uses a 1.6x multiplier and divides by zoom; it works, but direction is inverted relative to the finger (dragging right moves the focus left = image moves right), which is fine and natural

test_guests_wishes_uploads.py::test_bulk_normalise_dedupe_events is flaky under xdist because tests in the class share a card fixture (TEST Open guest added by another test); make the test use its own card
seed_data_creation: Users 9123400008/9123400009 (OTP 123456). Published card card_33375279e02c slug test-meal-sara (3 events, e1 lunch, e2 custom Biryani, e3 none, hero photo arch/blended).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile wizard uses wizard-step-select (select_option with the index string) instead of step tabs below 640px. Photo inputs: wizard-photo-{hero,feature,wishes,event-N}-input via set_input_files; the dialog testid is <slot>-adjust and the photo inside it is <slot>-adjust-photo (data-shape/data-style). Wait about 2s after opening before taking a screenshot; the image loads lazily. The Zoom slider thumb is '[data-testid=...-adjust-zoom] [role=slider]' (use ArrowRight). Guest calendar links show after clicking add-calendar-button. The browser tool mangles f-string screenshot paths, so use plain string names.
